cc:Work.dc:title: Validation-selected models on Farm 6
cc:Work.dc:description: Within-farm point RMSE and static/rolling interval Winkler scores. Model order follows the protocol. Kernel models use all three seeds; HistGBR uses seed 0. Bars show seed ranges.
